subject.title: improve(ui): replace the chat settings popover with a composer view menu

question: Should upgraded users lose the existing always/off auto-scroll choices, and should microphone selection move from the documented composer control to Settings → Appearance?
rationale: These are intentional user-facing behavior and placement changes that source correctness cannot settle without product intent.

options.title: Split the decisions
options.body: Land the View-menu and Talk-ownership cleanup separately, then review auto-scroll removal and microphone relocation as explicit product changes.

options.title: Preserve current choices
options.body: Keep the existing auto-scroll modes and composer microphone picker while removing only dead or misplaced controls.

options.title: Approve the contraction
options.body: Accept near-bottom-only scrolling and Settings-only microphone selection with updated documentation and direct upgrade/UI proof.

recommendation.title: Split the decisions
recommendation.body: Land the View-menu and Talk-ownership cleanup separately, then review auto-scroll removal and microphone relocation as explicit product changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available Control UI and Talk history makes this contributor the strongest routing candidate for the product decision.
